## 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or improvement.

## 🎯 Problem Statement / Use Case
What problem does this feature solve? Who will benefit from it?

## 📐 Proposed Architectural Solution
Describe how this could be implemented, including any affected packages or modules.

## 🔄 Alternative Considerations
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.
